bcachefs-module.install:
# Construct a shared initrd containing the bcachefs/mkfs/fsck bins.
#  We do this hear because we need to copy additional libs into the initrd,
#  and those libs ABSOLUTELY MUST be ABI compatible with the libraries in the
#  base initrd. The safest way to achieve that is to create the initd here
#  instead of in the bcachefs-tools build. By doing this the bcachefs tools
#  initrd is guaranteed to be rebuilt immediately after the root initrd is
#  built, guaranteeing ABI compatibility.
%install_dir initrd/%(libdir)/systemd/system-generators
%install_exe %(sbindir)/bcachefs initrd/%(sbindir)/bcachefs
%install_file %(udevrulesdir)/64-bcachefs.rules -t initrd/%(udevrulesdir)/
ln -srv initrd/%(sbindir)/bcachefs initrd/%(libdir)/systemd/system-generators/bcachefs-mount-generator
for i in fsck.bcachefs mount.bcachefs; do
    ln -srv initrd/%(sbindir)/bcachefs initrd/%(sbindir)/${i}
done

# We need to copy in the libs that are needed to run the binary
function copy_or_symlink() {
    file=$1

    if test -h %(libdir)/${file}; then
        link=$(readlink %(libdir)/${file})

        ln -s ${link} initrd/%(libdir)/${file}
        copy_or_symlink ${link}
    else
        cp -a %(libdir)/${file} initrd/%(libdir)/${file}
    fi
}

readarray -t libs <<<"$(${READELF} -d %(sbindir)/bcachefs | grep "NEEDED" | awk '{print $5}' | sed -e 's|\[||g' -e 's|]||g')"
for i in ${libs[@]}; do
    case $i in
        # We know for sure these are in the root initrd. Many of the rest are as well
        #  but there's very little space wasted by including duplicates
        libzstd.so.1|libz.so.1|libgcc_s.so.1|libc.so.6|ld-linux-x86-64.so.2)
            continue
            ;;
        *)
            copy_or_symlink ${i}
            ;;
    esac
done

pushd initrd
find . -exec touch -d @0 --no-dereference {} \;
find . | cpio -o -H newc --device-independent --reproducible | zstd -19 -T0 -c > ../bcachefs-tools.initrd
popd
%install_file bcachefs-tools.initrd %(installroot)%(libdir)/kernel/initrd.d/65-%(name)-shared.initrd

for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    pushd ${_kernel}
    %install_file src/fs/bcachefs/bcachefs.ko -t %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/extra/fs/bcachefs

    # Manually construct the debug info from the kernel modules
    %install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)/debug/.build-id
    pushd %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}
    module_list=()
    while IFS=  read -r -d $'\0'; do
        module_list+=("$REPLY")
    done < <(find . -type f -name "*.ko" -print0)
    for module in "${module_list[@]}"; do
        build_id=$(${READELF} -n ${module} | awk '/Bui/ {print $3}')
        debug_path="%(libdir)/debug/.build-id/${build_id:0:2}/${build_id: 2}.debug"

        pushd $(dirname ${module})
        file=$(basename ${module})

        llvm-objcopy --only-keep-debug "${file}" "${file}.debug"
        llvm-objcopy --add-gnu-debuglink "${file}.debug" "${file}"
        llvm-strip -g --strip-unneeded "${file}"
        %install_file "${file}.debug" "%(installroot)/${debug_path}"
        rm -v "${file}.debug"

        popd
    done
    popd

    # Create an initrd for .ko files
    mkdir -p initrd/%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/extra/fs/bcachefs
    find %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules -name '*.ko' -exec cp -v {} initrd/%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/extra/fs/bcachefs \;
    touch initrd/.dracut-depmod-invalidate
    pushd initrd
    %install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)/kernel/${_kernel}
    find . -exec touch -d @0 {} \;
    find . | cpio -o -H newc --device-independent --reproducible | zstd -19 -T0 -c > %(installroot)%(libdir)/kernel/${_kernel}/70-%(name)-%(version).initrd
    popd

    # Compress modules with zstd
    find "%(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/" -name '*.ko' -print -exec zstd {} \; -exec rm -v {} \;

    popd
done

broadcom-sta-module.setup:
for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    # Debian patches require the source in a certain structure. We imitate that structure even though we don't build for i386
    mkdir -p ${_kernel}/amd64 ${_kernel}/i386
    bsdtar-static -xf %(sourcedir)/broadcom.tar.gz --strip-components=0 -C ${_kernel}/amd64
    bsdtar-static -xf %(sourcedir)/broadcom.tar.gz --strip-components=0 -C ${_kernel}/i386

    pushd ${_kernel}

    # This is basically a hack so that the Debian patches apply cleanly. This file is not installed
    cp %(sourcedir)/README.txt README.txt

    # Also a hack for compat with 01-shipped-module.patch
    mv amd64/lib/wlc_hybrid.o_shipped amd64/lib/wlc_hybrid.o_amd64

    if [[ -f %(pkgdir)/patches/series ]]
    then
        # This retains patch order while removings blank lines
        # and lines starting with a # character (with any number of preceding blanks)
        # which should make the patch series file nicer to maintain due to comment support
        PATCHES=($(sed -E -e '/^\s*$/d' -e '/^[[:space:]]*#.*$/d' %(pkgdir)/patches/series))
        for p in "${PATCHES[@]}"
        do
            %patch "%(pkgdir)/patches/${p}"
        done
    fi

    # Might as well delete the i386 directory since we don't need it
    rm -rf i386
    popd
done
broadcom-sta-module.build:
for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    pushd ${_kernel}/amd64
    %ccache_zero
    export CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}"
    %make LLVM=1 KBASE="%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}" KERNELRELEASE=${_kernel}
    %ccache_stats
    popd
done
broadcom-sta-module.install:
%install_file %(pkgdir)/modprobe.conf %(installroot)%(libdir)/modprobe.d/broadcom-wl.conf

for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    pushd ${_kernel}/amd64
    %install_file wl.ko -t %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/extra/wireless/

    # Manually construct the debug info from the kernel modules
    %install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)/debug/.build-id
    pushd %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}
    module_list=()
    while IFS=  read -r -d $'\0'; do
        module_list+=("$REPLY")
    done < <(find . -type f -name "*.ko" -print0)
    for module in "${module_list[@]}"; do
        build_id=$(${READELF} -n ${module} | awk '/Bui/ {print $3}')
        debug_path="%(libdir)/debug/.build-id/${build_id:0:2}/${build_id: 2}.debug"

        pushd $(dirname ${module})
        file=$(basename ${module})

        llvm-objcopy --only-keep-debug "${file}" "${file}.debug"
        llvm-objcopy --add-gnu-debuglink "${file}.debug" "${file}"
        llvm-strip -g --strip-unneeded "${file}"
        %install_file "${file}.debug" "%(installroot)/${debug_path}"
        rm -v "${file}.debug"

        popd
    done
    popd

    # Compress modules with zstd
    find "%(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/" -name '*.ko' -print -exec zstd {} \; -exec rm -v {} \;

    popd
done

# libtest.sh hardcodes mktemp -d /var/tmp, which does not exist in the build root
mkdir -p /var/tmp
# test-run.sh aborts (SIGABRT) in the build container, matching Arch's "Broken in our
# build containers" note
%meson_test --exclude test-run.sh

build-essential.install:
%install_dir %(installroot)%(docdir)/build-essential
echo "This file will disappear when virtual packages are introduced" > %(installroot)%(docdir)/build-essential/README

buildah.build:
export BUILDTAGS="containers_image_ostree_stub libsqlite3 libsubid seccomp systemd"

# The containers/image prefix has changed domain names so in order to ensure that we use the correct setting regardless of which one is used just use both
%make PREFIX="%(prefix)" \
    EXTRA_LDFLAGS="-X github.com/containers/image/v5/signature.systemDefaultPolicyPath=%(datadir)/containers/policy.json \
                   -X go.podman.io/image/v5/signature.systemDefaultPolicyPath=%(datadir)/containers/policy.json"

bzip2.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/serpent/0001-Makefile-Allow-to-override-compiler-and-flags.patch

cp %(pkgdir)/bzip2.pc bzip2.pc
sed "s|@VERSION@|%(version)|" -i bzip2.pc
sed "s|@LIBSUFFIX@|%(libsuffix)|" -i bzip2.pc
bzip2.install:
%install_exe bzip2-shared %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bzip2
ln -sf bzip2 %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bunzip2
ln -sf bzip2 %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bzcat
%install_file bzip2.1 -t %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1
ln -sf bzip2.1 %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1/bunzip2.1
ln -sf bzip2.1 %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1/bzcat.1

%install_bin bzdiff
ln -sf bzdiff %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bzcmp
%install_file bzdiff.1 -t %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1
ln -sf bzdiff.1 %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1/bzcmp.1

%install_bin bzgrep
ln -sf bzgrep %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bzegrep
ln -sf bzgrep %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bzfgrep
%install_file bzgrep.1 -t %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1
ln -sf bzgrep.1 %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1/bzegrep.1
ln -sf bzgrep.1 %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1/bzfgrep.1

%install_bin bzmore
ln -sf bzmore %(installroot)/%(bindir)/bzless
%install_file bzmore.1 -t %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1
ln -sf bzmore.1 %(installroot)/%(mandir)/man1/bzless.1

%install_bin bzip2recover

%install_file  -t %(installroot)/%(libdir) libbz2.so*
ln -sf libbz2.so.%(version) %(installroot)/%(libdir)/libbz2.so
ln -sf libbz2.so.%(version) %(installroot)/%(libdir)/libbz2.so.1
ln -sf libbz2.so.%(version) %(installroot)/%(libdir)/libbz2.so.1.0
%install_file bzlib.h -t %(installroot)/%(includedir)
%install_file bzip2.pc -t %(installroot)/%(libdir)/pkgconfig/

subpackages.description: Runtime libraries for bzip2
